original_test_intent: Read the complete BMC GPU-management Event Log through both the Web page and OEM Redfish collection and confirm no warning or critical GPU event exists under an approved severity and time-window policy.
original_method: Authenticate through a protected read-only session with TLS/hostname validation, retrieve all collection pages and Web rows, bind every entry to the SUT/BMC/GPU and time window, normalize severity/message/state/timestamp and report all warning/critical records without clearing, acknowledging or filtering them away. Host ECC/NVSM data is supplemental only.
manual_activity: The owner supplies endpoint/schema, severity and time-window rules; an operator confirms Web pagination/filter state and reviews any warning/critical entry; the owner decides the verdict.
required_inputs: OEM Redfish endpoint/schema version and collection pagination contract
Protected read-only authentication and trusted TLS/hostname configuration
Severity normalization including warning, critical, active, cleared and acknowledged semantics
Time-window, timezone, duplicate-entry and retention rules
Web field/pagination/filter map and owner acceptance policy
safety_requirements: Never place credentials in URL, command line or artifacts
Use read-only GET/Web access with TLS and hostname validation
Do not clear, delete, acknowledge or mutate events
Do not accept one page, filtered Web view or host-only telemetry as complete evidence
Preserve raw responses, HTTP outcomes, next links and timestamps
Stop on warning/critical event, incomplete pagination, identity ambiguity or API/Web disagreement
No automatic retry that can conceal transient collection state
agent_execution_scope: Verify source identity and collect all Redfish pages read-only
Capture complete Web Event Logs coverage and current filter state
Normalize and correlate entries by GPU, timestamp, severity and state
Use nvidia-smi/NVSM only as supplemental correlation
Perform no log mutation, severity-policy decision, event disposition or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve endpoint/schema, severity decoder, time window and Web/API equivalence
Disposition every warning/critical, stale, duplicate or conflicting entry
Issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED after complete coverage review

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source embeds credentials in the Redfish URL and omits schema, pagination, severity, time-window and entry-state rules. DeepSeek replaces BMC EventLog evidence with host ECC/NVSM telemetry and insecure SSH.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Read-only collection is feasible once endpoint/schema, secure access, normalization and acceptance inputs are supplied.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2046 Wistron-BMC-01060-V002: approve the exact OEM Redfish endpoint/schema and Web field map, protected TLS authentication, pagination/deduplication, GPU/timezone/time-window and warning/critical/active/cleared semantics; define disposition rules while confirming host nvidia-smi/NVSM data is supplemental rather than a replacement.

review_improvement: Restores the exact BMC API/Web evidence source, removes credential exposure and host-telemetry substitution, and makes an empty/no-warning result traceable to complete pagination and severity mapping.
independent_technical_reasoning: ECC counters and NVSM alerts summarize different host-visible mechanisms and cannot prove the contents of an OEM BMC event collection. An empty first page can also be caused by pagination, filters or retention. Therefore the acceptance claim requires a schema-aware, fully paginated immutable BMC snapshot reconciled to the Web view and owner severity/time rules.
